apolloSites.source: NASA NSSDC Apollo Landing Site Coordinates, Lunar Module positions (Wagner et al. 2017, LRO images)

artemisPoints.note: area centroid and spherical centroid agree within 9 m on every region; the independently sourced Nobile Rim 2 point falls inside its region outline

mutationCheck.note: unchanged from the earlier build; no engine file changed

rootTests.note: one run showed a single timeout in the engine-runtime file under full-suite load; the re-run passed 122 of 122

skylineBuildOnLolaRasters.note: the six skylines from the earlier build were rebuilt byte-identical; one run stopped on a network failure and the re-run continued where it stopped

summary: The site library grows from 9 to 33 sites: 18 Artemis III candidate-region points (outline centroid and highest 20 m pixel per region, both labelled illustrative, not NASA-selected sites) derived from the USGS outlines, and the 6 Apollo landing sites from the NASA NSSDC coordinates. All 24 polar sites have a terrain skyline at 2 m: 22 grade B, 2 grade C. A failed network read during a skyline build is now retried twice, and an escaping network failure exits cleanly instead of crashing the process.
